headline.family_guess: serif display (Times/Georgia-like) for card interstitials ("THE", logo cards)
headline.case: sentence/mixed, occasional ALLCAPS on single-word cards
headline.size_rel: large, ~10-14% of frame height on interstitial cards

caption.case: sentence case, short phrase fragments (2-4 words)
caption.size_rel: small-medium, ~4-5% of frame height, bottom-third placed on pill chip

layout.host_pos: center-frame, chest-up, direct to camera; secondary co-founder interviews are split-frame (two stacked headshots) around t=39-43s
layout.safe_zones: top 8% and bottom 12% avoided for caption text; captions sit lower-third, never overlapping mouth region during demo shots
layout.caption_pos: one short caption pill per beat, roughly centered horizontally, vertically ~65-75% down frame; drifts to just-below-subject on cutaways

transitions: white full-bleed card interludes (logo/wordmark reveal) between demo sections
picture-in-picture / multi-window screen recording collage (app icons, code editor) inserted mid-explanation
medical/diagram illustration insert (anatomical cross-section) for credibility beat
split-screen two-speaker interview insert near end

themeable: accent color (brand red -> swap per channel/product)
accent2 (teal used only in one UI-recording insert, could drop)
